[Story]
Jianning and Mingkai are the co-captains of the football team. They still lack one team member. They joke that the remaining unselected players are "the best players". After a while, Mingkai does not speak, winks at Jianning, and then looks at Taotao, Taotao is one of the remaining unselected players. Mingkai turns his head and smiles at Jianning. Jianning nods his head, chooses Taotao to join their team. Taotao sees the wink and smile of Mingkai and Jianning.

[Question]
What does Taotao do next?

[Candidate Answers]
A. He walks towards Jianning and Mingkai, extends his hand, and shows a positive and friendly attitude.
B. He reinterprets this situation in a positive way, such as considering himself as a "hidden treasure" or "secret weapon", not the last one to be selected.
C. He shifts his attention to the upcoming game, not focusing on the order of being selected.
D. He talks to a good friend about his feelings, seeks support and comfort.
